title: festuca guestfalica subsp. calaminaria
intro: Festuca guestfalica subsp. calaminaria, commonly known as Calamint Festuca or Heavy Metal Tolerant Fescue, is a rare, heavy metal-tolerant grass species. This plant is known to have several health benefits, including its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve nausea, making it useful in the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of Festuca guestfalica subsp. calaminaria are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions, particularly in relation to its bioactive constituents.
